name: Zizzy
description: Engaged in dance performances, Zizzy creates cheerful spirits in Handong community as well as outside of the campus as a voluntary service in the villages.

name: Handong Orchestra
description: Handong Orchestra is the club that the string music club (Soloists) and the pipe music club (Winds) has generated. We engage in street music performances, and also perform in various regular events.

name: MIC (Motion in Christ)
description: Since 1996, MIC’s become famous for its passionate gospel ministry through spectacular dance performances.

name: Han Pung
description: Our members are passionate learners of the Korean traditional music instruments.

name: Holy Rams
description: Holy Rams is the American Football club and we have four football practices every week.

name: Armstrong
description: Armstrong, which is the only marine sports club in Handong, is a boat club.

name: CCC (Campus Crusade for Christ)
description: CCC holds chapel twice a week. We gather together every morning to worship God.

name: IVF (Inter-Varsity Christian Fellowship)
description: IVF is a Christian club which aims to evangelize the college campus.

name: Reformist Book Reading Club
description: This reading club is focused on reading classical books of Christianity.

name: DUDUS
description: We study about creation-science and hold an academic conference each year.

name: Linux Hackers
description: We form several teams to study Linux, develop mobile applications, webpages, and embedded machines.

name: CRA
description: We form groups to study C-programming and Java. One of our achievements was the development of the Intranet page.

name: GHOST
description: This club is established to study computer networks, security programs to prevent hacking and to develop software.

name: Giving Tree
description: Giving Tree manages the store to assist foreign students and participate in social services.

name: Peace Makers
description: We are ‘peace educators’ in the middle schools located in Pohang and mentors for children in orphanages.

name: Canvas
description: Helping students to share creative ideas to produce great art work. We hold art exhibitions twice a year.
